description: Personnel with assigned security roles and responsibilities do not receive role-based security and privacy training before being granted access and at least annually thereafter.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing role-based training curricula, lack of specialized training for privileged users, absence of training completion tracking by role, and no evidence of pre-access training requirements.
